verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents an official MCP server that lets any MCP-capable agent query live telemetry and investigate latency or error spikes. Its tool reference covers discovery, query, trace, Board, Trigger and SLO tools, and the documented REST API manages queries and offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec. A community report independently describes an LLM agent using Honeycomb's MCP server alongside other sources to debug incidents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that metrics and logs (not just traces) are queryable through the MCP/API tools, and the OpenAPI spec was not found at standard probe paths.
